digest.component_or_area: completion-close artifact publishing and ticket store access
propositions: Completion verification currently materializes the full ticket store despite reading only a small subset, causing 135–235 seconds of close latency
Close path publishes verdict, status, and signature through separate writes, risking durable inconsistency where one artifact persists after another fails
Lazy OID-pinned ticket view backed by ls-tree and batched cat-file must read from a stable tickets_oid snapshot without fallback to live state or cache writes
Receipt validation against descendant state must reject non-ancestor history and detect conflicts in changed ticket paths, relation predicates, and resolver bindings before atomic publication
Exactly one committed transaction must contain PASS verdict sidecar, closed status, and completion signature, with all three bound to one run identity or none committed
